model: scenario-weighted event DCF (LCD-finalizes vs LCD-fails), forward component owner-FCF build in bull/base, wind-down scenario value in bear

inputs.sbc_source: FY2026 Annual Report statement of changes in equity (Share Based Payment - Employee Remuneration $0.121m + Share Options $0.870m). NOTE: the Metrics.csv StockBasedComp column is the CUMULATIVE share-based-payments RESERVE balance, not the annual charge - only the YoY delta approximates the expense. No net-share-settlement withholding taxes (NZ option schemes), so sbc_incl_equity_taxes = sbc.
inputs.share_count_basis: ESTIMATE. 1,022.632m ordinary shares on issue at 31-Mar-2026 (FY2026 AR note 18; the CSV's 944.5m is the FY2026 WEIGHTED AVERAGE) + est. 240.7m new shares from the May-2026 NZ$25.4m placement and June-2026 NZ$10.7m retail offer at an ESTIMATED NZ$0.15/share (placement closed 12-May-2026 at ~14% discount to the NZ$0.174 pre-draft-LCD price; FY2026 AR does not state the issue price). Range 1,235m (if priced at 0.17) to 1,324m (if at 0.12). Dilution beyond this is genuine non-SBC issuance and is modelled EXPLICITLY per scenario: bull +42.9m (NZ$15m net at ~NZ$0.35, FY2028), base +120m (NZ$24m net at ~NZ$0.20, FY2028), bear +200m (NZ$10m emergency raise at ~NZ$0.05). projected_shares shows the BASE path. SBC itself is expensed in the flows with the count held flat (charge-once rule).
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-08-21T16:59:51+12:00 NZX regular close (Yahoo regularMarketTime), verified live
inputs.balance_sheet_date: 2026-03-31 (FY2026 AR), adjusted for the May/June 2026 NZ$36.1m raise: cash anchor = 7.776 + 34.1 net proceeds = NZ$41.9m, paired with FULL FY2027 flows in Year 1 so no burn is double-counted (modest conservative over-discount of ~5 elapsed months). TotalDebt is IFRS-16 lease liabilities only (NZ$1.285m) - lease treatment (A): liabilities in net debt, no flow adjustment (immaterial).
inputs.notes: MODEL CHOICE: PEB is pre-profit and cash-burning in every year FY2019-FY2026 (FY2026: revenue NZ$11.5m, owner FCF -NZ$33.6m). A conventional owner-FCF DCF extrapolating historical FCF is meaningless, and P/E / EV/EBITDA / FCF-yield anchors are undefined on negative earnings. Value is dominated by one binary regulatory event: Novitas draft LCD DL40378 (published 14-May-2026) proposing Medicare coverage for Cxbladder Triage and Triage Plus at US$1,328/test (75% above the legacy US$760), after the 24-Apr-2025 non-coverage destroyed ~56% of revenue. Per the dcf-methods routing table this takes the deal-completes-vs-deal-breaks weighting pattern, applied to the reimbursement decision: BULL = LCD finalized broadly as drafted by ~end-CY2026; BASE = finalized late (Novitas outside date 14-May-2027 +45 days) and/or narrowed, slower US rebuild off a hollowed-out salesforce (8-12 FTE vs 30+), one further raise; BEAR = LCD retired/excludes Cxbladder -> US wind-down, NZ/APAC + IP residual, heavy dilution. Bull/base are forward COMPONENT-BUILT 10-year owner-FCF DCFs (margins built per year from EBITDA/SBC/D&A/tax/capex/WC components - nothing extrapolated from the burned base year); bear is an asset/scenario value, not a growth DCF. Fresh build - no prior PEB.NZ DCF exists. Interest income (FY2026 NZ$0.52m) stripped from owner FCF because the raise-funded cash pile is added in the bridge. Mid-scenario raise proceeds are added to equity value at PV and the matching shares added to that scenario's count - at issue prices above model IV this is mildly accretive per share, which is mechanically correct.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: EPS and FCF CAGRs are undefined (negative in every year FY2019-FY2026). Equity CAGR is deeply negative because losses consume each raise. The 3yr revenue CAGR (-16.3%) is dominated by the Apr-2025 Medicare non-coverage event, not organic decline. NO historical CAGR is used as a projection driver - the scenario paths are event-driven (LCD outcome). selected_growth_rate 8.3% (revenue 5yr, through the coverage loss) is recorded only for the screener's PEG proxy.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - interest income), NZ$m: FY2019 -18.4, FY2020 -16.3, FY2021 -17.1(SBC-heavy grant year), FY2022 -21.8, FY2023 -32.7, FY2024 -31.8, FY2025 -29.3, FY2026 -33.6. SBC annual charge ~NZ$1.0-1.5m/yr; interest income 0.2-3.4m/yr (peaked FY2024 on the FY2022 NZ$100m raise pile).

base.narrative: LCD finalized but LATE (toward the Novitas outside date of May-2027 + 45-day effectiveness lag) and/or with narrower billing in practice; claim-by-claim Medicare revenue trickles through FY2027; US volume rebuild is slow because the salesforce was cut to 8-12 FTE and must be rebuilt after coverage certainty; commercial payer wins (BCBS NC/SC/KC, Highmark, Sentara) and NZ/APAC (growing ~13% q/q, nearing regional profitability) carry the interim. Revenue NZ$12.5m FY2027 -> NZ$89m FY2036; EBITDA breakeven ~FY2030 at ~NZ$44m revenue (FY2026 cost base ~NZ$44m opex, cut to NZ$2.5m/mo burn target); one further NZ$25m raise (NZ$24m net) in FY2028 at ~NZ$0.20 adding 120m shares.

bull.narrative: LCD finalized broadly as drafted by ~end-CY2026, effective within 45 days; Cxbladder Triage/Triage Plus become the ONLY covered urine biomarkers for hematuria (a de facto reimbursement moat), Triage Plus at US$1,328 (~NZ$2,250/test); salesforce rebuilt through FY2028; Surveillance Plus adds a second leg from FY2029 (crosswalk to US$1,800 sought). Revenue NZ$15m FY2027 -> NZ$166m FY2036 (roughly 70-75k US tests/yr at the new price - still a fraction of the claimed US$10.8bn TAM); mature EBITDA margin 30%; modest NZ$15m top-up raise in FY2028 at ~NZ$0.35 post-re-rate (+42.9m shares).

bear.narrative: Novitas retires the draft LCD or finalizes it excluding/narrowing Cxbladder (it has reversed course on this product before - the 2023-25 non-coverage saga). Clarity arrives ~mid-CY2027 with cash nearly exhausted (~NZ$4.4m at NZ$2.5m/mo target burn); management's own words: 'significant restructuring and potentially raise further capital'. US operations wound down (-NZ$5m cost); residual value = NZ/APAC business (~NZ$2-3m revenue, market-dominant in NZ, near regional profitability: ~NZ$8m at ~3x sales) + IP/clinical-evidence salvage to an acquirer (~NZ$7m) + emergency NZ$10m raise at ~NZ$0.05 (+200m shares). NOT a growth DCF - an asset/scenario waterfall. Bear IV NZ$0.016 is deliberately near zero and not floored.

assumptions.wacc_rationale: NZD flows discounted at an NZD-built rate: NZ 10yr risk-free ~4.3% + NZ equity risk premium ~5.5% x beta ~1.2 = ~11% standard NZ/AU small-cap cost of equity, PLUS structural premiums per the Step-8c template: micro-cap illiquidity (NZX, mkt cap < NZ$350m, thin turnover) +2.0%; single-product concentration (one test franchise, one disease area) +1.5%; pre-profit financing/execution risk (repeated raises, hollowed-out salesforce to rebuild) +1.5% => 16.0%. The Medicare/Novitas single-regulator BINARY itself is deliberately NOT in the WACC - it is charged once, in the scenario probabilities (charge-risk-once rule); adding a regulatory premium on top would double-charge it. Same 16% WACC across bull/base (no per-scenario WACC differences).

bear.note: No 10-year flow projection - bear is a wind-down scenario value (see assumptions.bear.components_nzd_m). FY2027 revenue ~NZ$12m (claim-by-claim + NZ/APAC) then US wind-down through FY2028.

base.terminal_pct_note: Degenerate ratio: near-zero EV (PV of FY2027-30 burn -41.0 offsets PV of profitable years +18.6 and most of the terminal). Substantively ALL of the base equity value is terminal value plus net cash.

bear.note: Wind-down scenario value; near zero by design, not floored. TV concept n/a.

entry_price.note: Entry = price at which buying today, funding the interim burn path, and exiting at the WACC-based fair terminal value earns 15% IRR. Because WACC (16%) exceeds the 15% hurdle, entry prices sit marginally ABOVE intrinsic values - the model's required return is already stricter than the hurdle. The actionable buy-below price is the weighted NZ$0.058.

required_return_table.note: Full base-case DCF recomputed at each required return (Gordon TV at the same rate, 15x cap). Even at a 9% required return the base case is worth NZ$0.099 - the current NZ$0.25 price is not reachable on the base path at ANY conventional discount rate; it requires the bull path at ~9-10% rates or better.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Deal-completes-vs-deal-breaks weighting on the LCD, not three growth guesses. Finalization-in-some-form = 80% (bull 35% as-drafted-and-on-time + base 45% late/narrowed/slow-rebuild): the draft LCD explicitly names ONLY Cxbladder for coverage, the Feb-2026 CAC was strongly supportive, and drafts proposing coverage usually finalize. Bear 20%, above the 15% house default, because Novitas retains full discretion, has ALREADY reversed course on this exact product once (2023-25), the outside date runs to May-2027, and failure is entwined with going-concern risk (management's own restructuring warning).
probability_weighted.band_note: Degenerate on purpose: SBC is ~1.5-2% of revenue so the house/street band is only ~NZ$0.005 wide, and the NZ$0.25 price sits ~42 band-widths above the street ceiling. SBC treatment is irrelevant to this stock's pricing - the entire debate is the LCD probability and the size of the recovered US business.

sanity_check.note_on_undefined_multiples: P/E and EV/EBITDA are UNDEFINED for PEB in every year FY2019-FY2026 (net income, EBITDA and FCF all negative) - they are deliberately not computed rather than emitting garbage. P/Sales and P/B (equity positive throughout) are the only meaningful anchors.
sanity_check.outliers_excluded: FY2021-FY2022 (COVID-era biotech mania: price NZ$0.90-1.15, P/Sales 60-107x) excluded from averages, kept in table for visibility.

current_market_multiples.note: NZ$0.25 x ~1,263m shares = ~NZ$316m market cap vs FY2026 revenue NZ$11.5m - ABOVE the 10y ex-outlier average P/Sales of 14.5x and in the upper region of the non-mania historical range. The market is already pricing substantial LCD success.

sanity_check.trip_check: No trips: base-case upside is -82% (not >+100%); implied base P/Sales 5.4x is BELOW the 14.5x historical ex-outlier average; implied P/B 1.4x is below both the 6.2x average and 1.5x the 32.7x max; price NZ$0.25 sits in the LOWER 13% of the 10y NZ$0.059-1.53 range.
sanity_check.diagnosis: No fix required. The structural-WACC-premium template (Step 8c.5 item 2) was applied BY DESIGN at build time (+5.0% over the 11% NZ small-cap base: illiquidity +2.0, single-product +1.5, pre-profit financing +1.5), with the regulatory binary charged in scenario weights instead of WACC to avoid double-charging.
sanity_check.reverse_sanity: The check cuts the OTHER way here: the model says the market, not the model, is paying an unprecedented-adjacent multiple. To justify NZ$0.25 at a 15-16% required return needs ~NZ$60-70m of FY2036 owner FCF (~NZ$220m+ revenue, ~2x the model's bull) - i.e. the price embeds near-certain LCD finalization PLUS flawless decade-long US commercialization, or a sub-10% discount rate on the bull path (bull at 9-10% = NZ$0.19-0.22).

valuation_philosophy.why_not_a_conventional_dcf: PEB has never generated positive FCF (owner FCF -NZ$16m to -NZ$34m every year FY2019-FY2026) and FY2026 revenue halved on a single payer decision. Extrapolating any historical series - growth, margin, or FCF - describes the pre-non-coverage business, which no longer exists. The valuation is therefore built FORWARD from the binary event: probability-weighted LCD outcomes, each with its own component-built path and its own explicitly-modelled dilution.
valuation_philosophy.the_finding: House weighted IV NZ$0.055 (street NZ$0.060) vs NZ$0.25: the model says the price already pays for LCD success several times over at a risk-appropriate discount rate. Even the BULL case (only-covered-biomarker moat, US$1,328 pricing, revenue rebuilt to 7x FY2026 by FY2036) is worth NZ$0.092 at 16% - a third of the price. The stock is only 'cheap' if you (a) hold the bull path at near-certainty AND (b) discount below ~10%. Conversely the bear is near-total loss (NZ$0.016, -94%). This is a binary-event lottery priced above its actuarial value, not a margin-of-safety situation - the model's buy-below price is NZ$0.058.
valuation_philosophy.what_would_move_it: Final LCD publication (content + effective date) is the single dominant input: as-drafted finalization moves weight from base/bear to bull (all-bull at 16% = NZ$0.092; the price then requires the market's implied ~9% rate or TAM-scale revenue beyond the modelled bull). Retirement/exclusion collapses the value toward NZ$0.016. Secondary: Q2-Q3 FY2027 claim-by-claim Medicare receipts (evidence on rebuild pace), the actual May/June-2026 issue price (fixes the ~1,235-1,324m share-count estimate), and Surveillance Plus CPT-PLA progress (Dec-2026).
